name: Complex Phase Cancellation Disguise
description: Replaces the easily simplified infinite geometric series convergence condition with a finite sum of complex exponentials over four intervals. Because the difference between any two multipliers from {1,2,3} is at most 2, the sum evaluates to exactly 0 if and only if the multipliers are distinct (as the roots of unity cancel), mapping equivalently to the original inequality without using obvious real-number comparisons.
